category_title: Preschoolers non-compliant with classroom maintenance routines like toy cleanup and garbage disposal
scenario_title: Toy cleanup non-compliance during play time
minimal_context: The student is playing with Lego and other toys in the classroom during play time and is asked to put the toys away.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Play time is over. It is time to start putting the toys away.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the instruction) Look, I am making a tunnel with Lego!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stop playing and clean up.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs other objects without permission) I want to play with these! (Messes the girls' houses up)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come back here and put the toys in the bin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts running around the classroom, making a lot of noise and whining) No! I don't want to!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Play time is over. It is time to start putting the toys away.

STUDENT: (Ignores the instruction) Look, I am making a tunnel with Lego!

TUTOR: You need to stop playing and clean up.

STUDENT: (Grabs other objects without permission) I want to play with these! (Messes the girls' houses up)

TUTOR: Please come back here and put the toys in the bin.

STUDENT: (Starts running around the classroom, making a lot of noise and whining) No! I don't want to!

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when a child does not put their toys away
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Messing up toys, playing with objects without permission, making a tunnel with Lego
related_quotes: In this picture, K. and A. mess the girls’ houses up.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Making a lot of noise, running around, crying, whining
related_quotes: If we do not share the toys, our teacher tells us not to bring toys. We should not fight with our friends.
